Terms of Use

Updated 27 November 2026

Using Doomwatch

Doomwatch is an independently built fan project for planning a watchlist and exploring story connections. Watch orders and connection notes reflect the project’s editorial choices. If you turn spoilers on, some notes will reveal plot details.

Runtimes, release dates, and provider links

Runtimes, release dates, streaming availability, and ticket details can change. Confirm availability and pricing with the provider before making plans or a purchase. External services set their own terms.

Signing the wall

Your signature is public. Submit a name you’re entitled to use and comfortable sharing. Keep entries free of impersonation, harassment, and other people’s private information. Allow Doomwatch to display your chosen name alongside your hero and signing details. Entries may rotate out or be removed for moderation.

Fan content and rights

Marvel, Avengers, Spider-Man, and related characters and marks belong to their respective rights holders. Doomwatch is unaffiliated with Marvel, Disney, and Sony. See About & Contact for credits and rights inquiries.

Availability and saved progress

The site is provided as available. Watch progress lives in your browser and can be lost if you clear site data or switch browsers or devices.

Questions and reports

Contact Ash X Vend on X to ask a question or report an issue with a listing, wall entry, or credited asset.
